title: Normalize robot serial identifiers
summary: A robotics fleet importer normalizes serial identifiers and resolves collisions in a deterministic way. Return the cleaned identifiers while retaining the required correspondence to input records. Normalize robot identifiers and resolve duplicates deterministically.
requirements: Trim whitespace, uppercase, and remove non-alphanumeric characters.
Use ROBOT if the cleaned name is empty.
Append -2, -3, etc. to duplicated identifiers in input order.
hints: First compute a canonical uppercase alphanumeric base.
Track used identifiers and add the smallest unused numeric suffix.
